Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Freya is getting internal alignment around a pilot and Legal/Security asked me to pull together the evidence pack for the no-adaptive-training ("no-train") commitment we discussed. They sent a short list of artifacts they need before the pilot kickoff: 

- Signed contract amendment (DPA addendum) confirming no-training / model improvement opt-out for our tenant
- Operational evidence that no customer data is used for model improvement (logs, telemetry policy, ephemeral KV behavior)
- Current subprocessor inventory and whether any subprocessor has KV or model-update access
- SFTP export instructions and audit trail options for tenant exports (they prefer SFTP over API for the first phase)
- Confirmation of KMS residency and whether customer-provided keys are supported for the pilot

Can you confirm what you can provide as deliverables and an estimated timeline? Legal would like to see the evidence pack and a DocuSign amendment we can sign before the end of the month if possible.

Also copying Freya Legal (legal@freyahealth.com) for visibility.

Thanks,
Lina

Marissa / Lina — quick technical addendum for the evidence pack. Below are concrete items we can include as screenshots/configs and an operational note about guarantees.

Technical artifacts we can provide (examples):
- Capture flow diagram (showing request ingest -> ephemeral KV -> inference -> sanitized logs) and a sample sanitized log export (log fields redacted to PII standards)
- KV eviction policy doc (default TTL behavior, how tenant-scoped keys are isolated)
- Audit log extract from a staged tenant (CSV) showing SFTP transfers and API calls with timestamps
- Subprocessor list: current infra and cloud partners (all secondaries have no write access to model weights; we will include attestation language)
- SFTP: we will provide host details for a customer-dedicated SFTP endpoint (sftp.frewood-inference.com:2222) with per-tenant path and per-user SSH key support; sample rsync command and audit log sample included
- KMS: we support customer-provided keys via AWS KMS with regional key material; for pilot we can reserve keys in us-west-2 or us-east-1 depending on your residency need

Operational note: our no-train commitment for pilot tenants is enforced by policy (no logging route to model-update pipeline + access control) and an operational runbook that we will include. If Freya requires cryptographic proof beyond the attestation (e.g., signed S3 inventory), escalate and we can scope additional controls.

I attached a short test export (freya_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) with redactions as a placeholder for the formats we will provide.

-David
